onb.title: Set up your business
onb.subtitle: Tell us what you sell. You can change most of this later.
onb.type: What do you want to do on Ciuna?
onb.type.store.body: Food, groceries and goods, delivered or picked up.
onb.type.expert.body: Translation, legal help, tutoring and other services, booked by time.
onb.country.hint: This decides which verification documents we ask for.
onb.operating: Where do you sell or deliver?
onb.operating.hint: Customers there will see your listings.
onb.languages.hint: Choose at least one. You write your listings in these languages.
setup.title: Set up and verify
setup.subtitle: Complete these steps. Ciuna reviews your business before you go live.
setup.profile.body: Add your description in your main language and contact details.
setup.verify.title: Verification
setup.verify.body: We ask for different documents depending on where your business is based.
setup.tier1.body: For individuals and self-employed sellers. Lower limits.
setup.docs.title: Documents
setup.listing.body: Save it as a draft now. You can publish once Ciuna approves your business.
setup.submit.title: Submit for review
setup.submit.ready: Everything is ready. Ciuna usually reviews within one business day.
setup.submit.notReady: Some steps are still open. You can submit once they are done.
errors.APPLICATION_INCOMPLETE: Some steps are still open. Complete them, then submit.
errors.PATH_INVALID: That upload isn't valid. Try again.
